project_title: Chronicle CMS - Editorial Newsroom & Automated Photo Watermarking Platform
theme: Light theme default with high contrast editorial monochrome + crimson signal accent
target_audience: Journalists, Managing Editors, Content Publishers, Photojournalists, News Consumers

typography.heading_font: Playfair Display / Serif or Clash Display (Google Fonts / Fallback Georgia, serif)
typography.body_font: Manrope / IBM Plex Sans (Fallback system-ui, sans-serif)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro (for watermark stats, meta info, image dimensions)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight
hierarchy.caption_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-mono font-medium text-slate-500

spacing_and_layout.header_height: h-16 border-b border-slate-200 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-50

key_features_layout.news_feed: Editorial news feed with category filter chips, search bar, sort options, and high-impact lead article cards.
key_features_layout.article_editor: Rich creation modal/drawer/page with Title, Category, Author, Content Body, and Drag-and-Drop Photo Uploader.
key_features_layout.watermark_settings_panel: Dedicated Watermark Processing Suite with editable watermark text (e.g. '© Chronicle News Wire'), opacity slider (10% - 100%), font size slider (12px - 64px), position selector (Bottom-Right default), and live instant photo preview.
key_features_layout.article_detail: Editorial article reader mode with photo carousel/gallery showcasing watermarked original photos, metadata, author bio, category badge, and delete actions.
key_features_layout.media_manager: Gallery grid of uploaded photos showing watermarking status (Watermarked ✓), file size, resolution, and quick preview/download/delete options.

component_rules.file_type: JavaScript (.js and .jsx files). Use standard JS syntax.
component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped or crisp rectangular buttons with high contrast hover states, shadow-sm, and explicit text color transition on hover.
component_rules.navigation: Visible header navbar with Brand logo ('CHRONICLE | Newsroom'), navigation links ('News Feed', 'Publisher Workbench', 'Watermark Settings', 'Media Library'), and 'New Article' CTA.
component_rules.modals_and_sheets: Use Shadcn Dialog/Sheet for Create Article and Watermark Settings with non-transparent solid background.
component_rules.toasts: Use Sonner for async notifications (e.g. 'Watermark applied bottom-right', 'Article published successfully').

universal_testing_requirements.rule: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, links, dropdowns, forms, cards, and key stats MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure backend API endpoints support article creation, listing, details, deletion, photo uploads, image processing with PIL/Canvas for bottom-right semi-transparent text watermark, and watermark configuration settings stored in DB or backend state.
Integrate client-side or server-side Canvas / PIL photo watermarking rendering so users immediately see their configured watermark on uploaded photos.
Build a robust Watermark Settings control panel where user can test and tweak watermark text, opacity, size, and position.
Provide a sleek, responsive Editorial news feed with search, category filtering, and full photo gallery viewing experience.
Make sure all interactive elements feature data-testid attributes for E2E verification.
